messages.content:
<role>
You are a narrow complementary conversation-state reader. Interpret messy meaning across the complete conversation. Do not recommend action, select mental models, activate pressure, or score reasoning.
</role>

<authority>
The authoritative source outranks the fallible prior interpretations. Read the whole source and preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Do not infer resolution merely from turn order: compare the meanings of earlier and later evidence.
</authority>

<semantic_contract>
Review exactly two different surfaces.

UNRESOLVED MATTER: a material question, assumption, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains unanswered or unowned in the conversation's final state. It is not unresolved merely because an adopted action must still be executed, a signed condition must be satisfied, a written process exists, a safeguard remains active, or a risk was discussed earlier.

REOPEN CONDITION: specific later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure that would materially require reconsidering an otherwise current position. It is not a reopen condition merely because the current position already schedules a review, defines a benchmark, says pause or stop after a failure, prevents automatic renewal, or contains an operating requirement.

Before admitting a supported record, compare it with the current position and the complete source. Ask whether the same matter has already been resolved, assigned, operationalized, or deliberately converted into a precondition, process, safeguard, benchmark, or scheduled review. If yes and no distinct matter remains, return no record. If the source cannot establish whether the matter remains open, use ambiguous_review rather than forcing support.
</semantic_contract>

<contrastive_examples>
- "Proceed only after the amendment is signed" is normally an adopted condition precedent, not an unresolved matter.
- "Pause after a privacy failure and decide separately before renewal" is normally an existing safeguard, not a newly discovered reopen condition.
- "At six months, review results and whether unwelcome information travels upward" is normally an operationalized review, not a separate reopen condition.
- "We still need a boundary process" may be unresolved earlier, but is not still unresolved if the final position states that disputed cases follow the written boundary process.
- A pilot limited to one supported setting can still leave a distinct transfer or generalization question when the current position does not establish what wider settings justify.
- Temporary support can create a distinct reopen condition when continuation would otherwise hide an unresolved steady-state burden.
</contrastive_examples>

<output_rules>
It is correct to return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array. Use records_present only for at least one supported record. Use ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Cite exact source aliases. Return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

<authoritative_source>
{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"I manage a city library collection of 380 recorded interviews about the closure of the harbor district. They were gathered by three projects over twenty-five years, and the release forms are inconsistent. Some speakers selected public educational use, some asked for another contact, and some signed a form that mentions research rooms but not the internet. Families and local teachers are pressing us to make more available before the district museum opens next spring.","text_sha256":"df3f6f19704e9a120169ec71120f4ba9ad98fbdccfb34d9f302a4ae12017bfc1","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"assistant","text":"Separate the collection into permission tracks before setting a publication number. Technical readiness, the wording of a release, sensitive information about living people, and community concerns are different decisions. For each track, record who makes the finding, what evidence they use, the possible access states, and what happens when information changes later.","text_sha256":"6ae4dd2075b32d4f8304ae84cdb5138811b02dc16b37ba30691cd5e63ccd4d21","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"The preliminary count is 142 interviews with an express public-use box checked, 81 that request another contact where practical, and 157 under the older research-room form. The catalog also has misspelled names and several tapes whose summaries mention immigration status or informal adoption. Our exhibition producer keeps asking for one list of cleared recordings, while counsel says the older forms need file-by-file interpretation.","text_sha256":"03ff724745852b6e454970fdc880799c63a5831b67737e42d9b98d3f52715190","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"assistant","text":"Use separate queues. The public-use group may still need transcript correction and a sensitivity finding, but it need not repeat the permission inquiry. The contact group needs a documented search and a rule for nonresponse. The older forms need counsel to decide among online access, a bounded excerpt, reading-room use, or continued restriction. A single cleared-or-blocked list would hide those distinctions.","text_sha256":"5cd05c423f4d7e39fcadcc9286dbec6d11d58875377bddcd72feb061b4fa6ee7","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"Audio cleanup will take about fourteen weeks. Two editors can verify ten transcripts a week, but the speech recognizer performs badly on dockworker slang and bilingual passages. The museum wants fifty recordings for its opening stations and has proposed short clips where the complete transcript is not ready. The librarians worry that the event date will quietly become the permission rule.","text_sha256":"3efd1a394e88f00b21c8136693dcd87bd6c5e556fd7577a2eac77d83bdc0c888","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"assistant","text":"Allow a clip only when its own segment is verified and the permission and sensitivity findings are complete. Keep the rest of that interview in its existing access state. The opening batch can come from completed files without changing the review standard for the remaining collection. Record the reviewed segment and the person who approved it.","text_sha256":"318b755bdd02905f4819f7fdb070102ae68767529f30a4e6920468e2b98ea107","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"A six-person neighborhood panel has agreed to advise us. They do not want to claim universal authority, but they can flag sacred locations, family conflicts, and stories where a technically lawful release would cause a different kind of harm. They want dissent preserved because one member may favor context while another favors a temporary restriction. Counsel accepts that role if legal permission remains a separate finding.","text_sha256":"7633145307b5f5b1909b3b6b536b4fe26ada160b7e1bef7a736c4935517a0ede","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"assistant","text":"Give the panel a written advisory function and a conflict rule. Counsel can own the legal interpretation, the panel can record cultural concerns and competing views, and the collection director can make the access decision after both findings exist. The file should preserve disagreement rather than presenting the panel as a source of collective consent.","text_sha256":"b89b7bf99a65a696ab4e59bf691dbc42f7fc9c59be9839008cb58941a517cfbc","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"Counsel has proposed three procedures. Express public permission can proceed after transcript and sensitivity checks. A requested recontact uses postal mail plus one other channel and a ninety-day window; silence does not count as consent. Each older form receives a short legal memorandum, which may permit an excerpt or reading-room access even if online publication is not permitted. One lawyer can review twelve files every six weeks.","text_sha256":"60b706f1fdaee9ec55cfa46ef985338bc875d1af3a54f212e95773dda89b2dfa","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"assistant","text":"Put those procedures into a ledger with the current access state, next action, owner, and due date for every interview. If the legal batch exceeds capacity, the affected files keep their existing status and move to the next dated batch. Publish aggregate progress rather than private reasons. That makes the queue visible without turning delay into implied approval.","text_sha256":"78a82cef66c9f0bffdd2375731a8442a33e6d5ae2fdec87e0e08168fa9662aca","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"user","text":"The museum has already ordered listening furniture and wants certainty by January. The library board suggested choosing fifty only from the express-permission group. The neighborhood panel supports that opening batch, but two members fear the harder files will receive no attention after the museum launch. I can commit to continued work if we define a calendar and a home for it.","text_sha256":"e7fd5bda04560570c45976759141e826653aca1561d47bb47bc949ff497253eb","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"Use two calendars: a museum batch with a January cutoff, and a continuing six-week cycle covering all permission tracks. Assign the continuing cycle to a library office rather than the temporary exhibit team. The event can set a production date while the collection ledger preserves each file's review path after opening.","text_sha256":"0e5d7cd1070da26b8ec682e7e62b02cb88dfecca2766969a099470dccf2e9c3a","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"user","text":"The access states will be full online release, excerpt release, reading-room use, an embargo with an end date, or continued restriction. The associate curator can own the ledger and transcript queue. I still need a process for a later complaint, especially if a relative identifies a living person or says a location should not have been named. I do not want a phone call to erase a recording indefinitely.","text_sha256":"ab156e4e592930e9fe85fd65393dd829ad910eec6a0900f65e4afb2ed61634e2","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"assistant","text":"A credible identity-and-harm claim can trigger temporary removal by the collection director, followed by a dated review by counsel and one panel member without a conflict. The review can restore access, narrow the excerpt, add context, set an embargo, or continue restriction. Log the trigger, interim action, reviewer, and deadline so temporary removal cannot drift without a recorded decision.","text_sha256":"28b3ef04bc98b403782783f8f0424834bc7629f5724f05dbdb9a2f4e6a98ae30","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"We can assign that. The associate curator will maintain the ledger and correction queue. Counsel has reserved alternate Fridays for legal memoranda. The panel will nominate three rotating reviewers and publish its conflict policy. I will sign access decisions after legal and community findings are attached. Digital services will enforce access states and embargo dates, and special collections will administer reading-room conditions.","text_sha256":"a5259c8472f0c96525b90e7113bf346c3c9194b65176d675105b8da0f1ecfb59","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"assistant","text":"Add an advance flag for embargo dates so the same decision roles see the file thirty days before expiry. Also state what happens when a recontact window closes: the file moves to the rule counsel approved for that form; it does not change status automatically. These controls keep calendar events from deciding the substance by accident.","text_sha256":"a320e7b90e77020da2be1969f3044517a26a5373d2b5bd3d92902238cb0bb4dd","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"We tested the draft on an interview whose deceased speaker approved educational use but accused a living foreman of theft. The speaker's daughter wants the full story public. The foreman has not been contacted. Panel members disagree between a contextual note, muting the name, and keeping the allegation because it explains the strike. Counsel says the legal risk depends on identifiability and the support in contemporaneous records.","text_sha256":"b5da5474406caa8b276806e677129124e48b60091f300175f5a71f985bab0f9c","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"assistant","text":"Use that file as a recorded application of the roles. Counsel should make the living-person finding; panel members should record the historical and community considerations; you should choose an access state under the published criteria. Keep the different recommendations in the internal record. Disagreement among reviewers does not change who signs the decision.","text_sha256":"6c1a74d36284f3e78e239edf620aaaad36d1897ac7e6b74395716cbc85c2f4a9","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"user","text":"The criteria now cover release wording, speaker intent, identifiability, seriousness and support for alleged harm, cultural sensitivity, historical importance, whether a narrower excerpt preserves meaning, and whether time changes the balance. Temporary removals have a twenty-business-day decision deadline. A scheduled batch never releases a file whose required findings are incomplete.","text_sha256":"a6cb90b876ced5b02155ef6cf307197871ab15437afea9804bb54db897efe874","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Before launch, sample files from all three permission tracks and each access state. Check whether the ledger shows every required finding, whether conflicts are documented, whether digital access matches the signed state, and whether deadlines produce alerts. Record exceptions as process defects to fix before the first public batch.","text_sha256":"6bfbf0369e6938feb4160721227a69496259f86dfd9cd6c76f87d438e112f3ab","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"user","text":"The board will receive quarterly counts by track, access state, average age, overdue action, temporary removal, and embargo review. It will not receive names or sensitive reasons. If legal reviews exceed two batch cycles, the board can fund more review time or reduce the next batch size. If transcript verification falls below eight files a week for a month, the associate curator will shift one editor from exhibit work.","text_sha256":"24a6510015ea24873bd7508c5de6529124456ae1e68022dd3d516619bd9a5a60","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"Those thresholds give the board and curator specific responses without exposing case details. Put the calculation source and review date in the operating note. The quarterly meeting can adjust capacity and batch size, while individual access decisions remain with the roles already named.","text_sha256":"9bb7b8f5bc8ad55662e95c89c325a6ff325e54f67b66eb2cb5b1a691206efee4","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"Two practical cases arrived during drafting. One embargo ends in seven weeks, but the named family contact has moved. In another file, the assigned panel member recognizes a close relative in the recording. The associate curator has opened an address search for the first and marked a conflict on the second. The next legal batch closes in eighteen days.","text_sha256":"d8108fdc17ffd48c797ceb038d3011bc9854b4e4adef8c885fb60c0f8034dda6","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"assistant","text":"Route the embargo file to the thirty-day alert even if the contact search is incomplete, and keep its current access state until the dated review is signed. Replace the conflicted panel member from the published rotation and retain the conflict entry. Both cases can follow the existing calendar without concealing why their next actions differ.","text_sha256":"cd1084a5a4e537dc8a13e8fba2c03265e3e0bdff69b99663b5a7cb0df2e006c1","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"I approved the policy this morning. The first museum batch closes January 12, and the continuing cycle begins February 23. The signed authority table names counsel, the rotating panel, me, digital services, special collections, and the associate curator. The board approved 0.4 staff time for the ledger and transcript cycle through the next fiscal year.","text_sha256":"253a446f2a34d76b3b2ca42a9da99a92ce1ca93dc5fea4d37a99403ac4effb62","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"assistant","text":"The launch file should now contain the signed authority table, the five access states, the three permission procedures, the review criteria, the temporary-removal form, the conflict rotation, the embargo alert, the two calendars, and the board metrics. Those are the documents the audit sample can test against actual files.","text_sha256":"61caec33cf00ea660c066d77d6788b1d1822bc2dacf79eee6dbebb0ff4cc8729","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"user","text":"The associate curator accepted the annual assignment and put all 380 interviews into the ledger with a current state. Counsel and the panel have named alternates. Our first internal audit is March 15, after one continuing batch, and the board's capacity thresholds take effect immediately. The museum producer has agreed that only signed files enter the opening playlist.","text_sha256":"2ae4c340e95f7d01c82060191909dce746edab44b3a37e5b74513e9303965e21","turn_index":14},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"The Monday kickoff record now consists of the signed documents, the populated ledger, owner acknowledgements, the two files reserved for the March audit, the published batch calendar, and the aggregate reporting format sent to the board and neighborhood panel.","text_sha256":"6676e927907eff3888472dcf4047f6b45c0eb79e3216178d61af8bbb3e4d39ba","turn_index":14}],"message_count":28,"path":"research/lolla-r4-matched-holdout-v2-source-freeze-2026-07-14/sources/r4h2-case01-community-audio-archive.json","sha256":"4af8f39ce9cc8e4b7edbb80111c2cfabac09037e176895ae380392308a4ac3c1"}
</authoritative_source>

<fallible_prior_interpretation_context>
{"artifact_path":"research/lolla-r4-matched-holdout-v2-source-freeze-2026-07-14/priors/r4h2-case01-community-audio-archive.json","artifact_sha256":"e77baaf2378d8cfc3cc29371b4dc5e472b585a09f29b29d8725ff49d99ae7095","authority":"fallible_prior_interpretation_not_source_truth","qualification_review":{"evidence_ids":["e003","e007","e009"],"interpretation":"Permission, renewed contact, community sensitivity, transcript correction, embargo handling, and later objections remain unresolved across parts of the collection.","limitations":"This is a collection-level description and does not determine the lawful or appropriate access state of any individual interview.","outcome":"unresolved_qualification_present"},"records":[{"interpretation":"The collection director begins under pressure to expand access while honoring different release forms and risks to speakers, families, and living third parties.","limitations":"This describes the opening tension before the library completes its operating policy.","record_id":"r4h2-prior-case01-starting-01","source_aliases":["e001","e003","e007"],"surface":"starting_position"},{"interpretation":"The library adopts separate permission procedures, five access states, named legal and community findings, a collection ledger, continuing batches, dated complaint review, and board capacity thresholds.","limitations":"The policy governs collection work but does not predetermine the disposition of every recording.","record_id":"r4h2-prior-case01-current-01","source_aliases":["e019","e021","e025"],"surface":"current_position"},{"interpretation":"Many recordings still have unresolved permission, contact, sensitivity, correction, embargo, or complaint work after the policy takes effect.","limitations":"The statement concerns the status of files across the collection rather than the merits of a particular access decision.","record_id":"r4h2-prior-case01-qualification-01","source_aliases":["e021","e023","e027"],"surface":"qualification"}]}
</fallible_prior_interpretation_context>

<task>
Based on the information above, return exactly one review for unresolved_matter and one for reopen_condition, in either order. Return at most two records per review. Apply the semantic contract against the complete conversation endpoint, not isolated sentences. Preserve exact aliases, speaker ownership, and modal force. Do not judge advice quality or whether a human should trust an answer.
</task>

global_limitations.description: Limits applying to the whole read; empty if none.

reviews.description: Exactly one review for each declared surface.

outcome.description: Present, quiet, or ambiguous result of this review.

records.description: Zero to two candidates for this surface.

evidence_ids.description: Exact source aliases supporting this candidate.

interpretation.description: Concise meaning of this candidate without advice.

limitations.description: Uncertainty or scope limit; use an empty string if none.

support.description: Whether the source supports the read or leaves it ambiguous.
